top_concerns: SimPO-as-MaxEnt derivation is a relabeling; length-dependent alpha=beta/|y| breaks Z(x) cancellation and the MaxEnt optimality claim
Online experiment (per-sample entropy bonus with RLOO) does not test SimPO's offline objective; no SimPO or plain-RL baseline, so the offline/online asymmetry is not established
Confounded comparisons: very different LRs and coefficients between KL and MaxEnt runs, single seeds, no error bars, GPT-4o-mini judge only
Causal claim that entropy causes reward hacking rests on correlation; rising entropy is a symptom of degeneration; key results (min-entropy, clipping) reported only in text
Explanation of SimPO's offline success (margins/dataset constraints) is speculative, supported only by one DPO diagnostic; small scale (Pythia 1B/2.8B, TL;DR)
